lines: Tujhko dariya-dili ki qasam, saaqiya
couplets.en: I ask it of you, cupbearer, by your open heart.

lines: Mustaqil daur par daur chalta rahe
couplets.en: Let the cup go round and round.

lines: Raunaq-e-maikada yun hi badhti rahe
couplets.en: May the tavern grow livelier still.

lines: Ek girta rahe, ek sambhalta rahe
couplets.en: Let one fall as another finds his feet.

lines: Sirf shabnam hi shaan-e-gulistaan nahin
couplets.en: Dew is only one of the garden's graces.

lines: Shola-o-gul ka bhi daur chalta rahe
couplets.en: Let flame and rose have their turn too.

lines: Ashk bhi chashm-e-purnam se behte rahe
couplets.en: Let tears keep falling from brimming eyes.

lines: Aur dil se dhuaan bhi nikalta rahe
couplets.en: And let smoke keep rising from the heart.

lines: Sirf shabnam hi shaan-e
couplets.en: Dew alone is not the glory...

lines: Tere chehre pe ye zulf bikhri hui
couplets.en: A lock of hair lies loose across your face.

lines: Neend ki god mein subah nikhri hui
couplets.en: Morning brightens in the lap of sleep.
